Package neqsim.process.util.scenario

Class CompressorAutomationStudy.Train

java.lang.Object
neqsim.process.util.scenario.CompressorAutomationStudy.Train
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
Enclosing class:
CompressorAutomationStudy
public static final class CompressorAutomationStudy.Train extends Object implements Serializable
Actual coupled objects and explicit physical-step execution contract for one train.

Equipment accessors return the live native identity graph so configuration, faults, control bindings and execution observe the same objects. Use copy() for an isolated train; coordinate updates and execution on one thread.

Version:
1.0
Author:
NeqSim
